value: Gryan Stoutmantle describes people driven from Westfall and asks for a lead on the Defias Brotherhood. The quest gives no calendar date and names no single attack that explains every departure. We begin among thin farms and dry roads, beside the militia post at Sentinel Hill, with Gryan’s report kept distinct from the unseen lives it summarizes.
editorNote: Quest 65 reports residents driven from the land; it does not locate a specific farm or establish one dated attack.
